title: If I could give no stars I would!
text:
If I could give no stars I would!. Only buy this blanket if you are ready to spend hours and hours getting fuzz out of your clothes.

I placed this in the washer upon arrival...and I made the mistake of adding it to my clothes load. There were dress pants and dress shirts for both my husband and I. When I took the load out I realized that everything, absolutely every single item in the drier was 100% covered in white fuzz. I had to wash everything again (minus blanket) and nothing came off so I had to start removing it all by hand. It is nearly impossible to do so without extra strenght wide tape...then I have to comb the reminder fuzz off and the final step is plucking it by hand. Do NOT buy this garbage!

UPDATE: kept the blankets for my pets to use...but I've noticed that even when I wash them separatedly from our clothes the material desintegrates and it adheres to the washing machine walls as well as the dryer's walls. Super hard to clean and get it all off. Now virtually all of our clothes have this awful fuss. I had to buy two different types of lint brushes on Amazon and still have not found one that is strong enough to remove this garbage off our clothes and furniture. It has become a nightmare.
